### token-spend: an elided path counts as a reference to (none) and can tie a real repo into the fallback

Found by the independent check on the studio bench's busiest day (tools/august-verify-attrib.go vs tools/august-repo-spend-paths.go, 2026-08-30). In the main pass, countWith records a reference whenever the working-root prefix is followed by path characters, and resolver.repoFor trims trailing dots and maps an all-dots name to the repo key (none).
